newsitem.title: USA: U.S. barge rates lightly quoted on call session.
newsitem.headline: U.S. barge rates lightly quoted on call session.

text.p: U.S. barge rates were lightly quoted on Monday at the St. Louis Merchants Exchange. No barges traded on Monday versus none on Friday.
- One barge, next week, Illinois River, bid 150 percent of tariff, offered at 160 percent.
- Eight barges, two each week of January, St Louis, Mississippi, bid 100 percent, offered 110 percent.
- Two barges, one each week of January 5 and January 12, Osceola through Cape Girardeau, Mississippi, $500 switched, bid 95 percent, no offer.
There will be no call sessions on Tuesday, December 31 and January 1, the exchange said.
